description: build_email_from_create sets blobId to Id::from("placeholder-blob") as a sentinel. If a backend's create_object forgets to replace it, clients receive blobId: "placeholder-blob" in Email/set and Email/get responses with no error or warning from the framework. The contract is only in a comment; there is no assertion or type-system enforcement.
title: placeholder-blob sentinel can escape to clients if backend forgets to replace it
